description: Applies chosen proposals of diagnose_search. SPENDS CREDITS: show the price of that combination and pass it as confirm_credits after the user's yes, with the diagnosis' `version`. For a finished search whose people ran out, `more` (and stop_at_target) say how many more leads to find with the changes. [REST: POST /api/tasks/{id}/revise]

confirm_credits.description: The price in credits the matching quote returned, shown to the user and confirmed by them.

task_id.description: The search id (task id), e.g. from list_searches or create_search.

version.description: The spec version from get_search (optional: protects against an edit made meanwhile in the web).

name: revise_search
title: Apply criteria changes (spends credits)
